result.instructions: Tools for AgendaPro, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which appointments do we have at my main location tomorrow, and which provider has free slots in the afternoon?"; "Find the client María López and show her upcoming bookings."; "Book a 60-minute service for client 42 with provider 5 next Tuesday at 10:00.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes AgendaPro data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run agendapro_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run agendapro_request_feature to record the request. Paid plan: Pro (unlimited tool calls (fair use limit: 10,000 a month), $9/month or $90/year). Pro can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run agendapro_upgrade (plan "monthly" or "yearly"); it returns a payment link for the user to open. agendapro_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: agendapro_list_locations
tools.title: List locations
tools.description: List the business's locations (sucursales / locales): id, name, address, phone, email, timezone, opening hours and country. Location ids are needed for bookings, slots and sales filters. GET /v3/locations.

page.description: Page number, from 1 (default 1). Pass pagination.next_page from the previous reply.

tools.name: agendapro_get_location
tools.title: Get location
tools.description: One location by id, with address, coordinates, timezone and weekly opening hours. GET /v3/locations/{id}.

tools.name: agendapro_list_services
tools.title: List services
tools.description: List the services (treatments, classes, sessions) the business offers: id, name, price, duration, type, category, whether online booking/payment is on, and the location. Service ids are needed to book. GET /v3/services.

page.description: Page number, from 1 (default 1). Pass pagination.next_page from the previous reply.

tools.name: agendapro_get_service
tools.title: Get service
tools.description: One service by id, including its category, images and the providers who perform it. GET /v3/services/{id}.

tools.name: agendapro_list_service_categories
tools.title: List service categories
tools.description: List service categories, ordered as the business arranges them. GET /v3/categories.

page.description: Page number, from 1 (default 1). Pass pagination.next_page from the previous reply.

tools.name: agendapro_list_providers
tools.title: List providers
tools.description: List service providers (the staff who take bookings): id, public name, location, active flag, online-booking flag and working hours. Provider ids are needed to book. GET /v3/providers.

service_ids.description: Only providers who perform these services.

public_name.description: Partial match on the provider's public name.

sort_by.description: Field to sort by, e.g. public_name.

page.description: Page number, from 1 (default 1). Pass pagination.next_page from the previous reply.

tools.name: agendapro_get_provider
tools.title: Get provider
tools.description: One service provider by id, with biography, images and working hours including breaks. GET /v3/providers/{id}.

tools.name: agendapro_list_bookings
tools.title: List bookings
tools.description: List bookings (reservas / appointments) with time, status, service, provider, client id, location, price and the linked sale. AgendaPro requires at least ONE of client_id, location_id, service_id or service_provider_id; dates only narrow the result. A sale may be a membership covering several bookings, so do not total amounts by sale id. GET /v3/bookings.

status_id.description: Filter by booking status id (see the status object on a booking).

page.description: Page number, from 1 (default 1). Pass pagination.next_page from the previous reply.

tools.name: agendapro_get_booking
tools.title: Get booking
tools.description: One booking by id with status, service, provider, client id, location, prices, notes and the linked sale. GET /v3/bookings/{id}.

tools.name: agendapro_list_available_slots
tools.title: List available slots
tools.description: Free booking time windows at a location on one date (optionally for one service and/or provider): start/end time, provider, plus a metadata summary (service duration, slot count). Use before creating a booking. GET /v3/available_slots.

tools.name: agendapro_create_booking
tools.title: Create booking
tools.description: WRITE: create a booking for an existing client, service, provider and location. Check agendapro_list_available_slots first. status_id must be a non-cancelled status: copy the status.id of an existing booking (agendapro_list_bookings). AgendaPro does NOT send email/SMS/WhatsApp notifications for bookings created through the API. Not idempotent: calling twice books twice. POST /v3/bookings.

start_time.description: Start, ISO 8601 with a timezone offset, e.g. 2026-03-10T10:00:00-03:00 (use the location's timezone).

end_time.description: End; defaults to start + the service duration.

price.description: Price as a decimal string; defaults to the service price.

time_resource_id.description: Time resource id; required when the service needs one.

tools.name: agendapro_update_booking
tools.title: Update booking
tools.description: WRITE: change an existing booking (partial update: only the fields you pass change): move it, switch service/provider/location, change status, price or notes. The merchant's customer policy applies: a change too close to the start time, or past the maximum number of changes, is refused with HTTP 422 and must not be retried. PATCH /v3/bookings/{id}.

start_time.description: New start, ISO 8601 with a timezone offset.

end_time.description: New end, ISO 8601 with a timezone offset.

status_id.description: New booking status id (copy from another booking's status.id).

time_resource_id.description: New time resource id; null removes the assigned resource.

tools.name: agendapro_cancel_booking
tools.title: Cancel booking
tools.description: WRITE: cancel a booking. This cannot be undone through the API. The merchant's customer policy applies: a cancellation that is disabled, too close to the start time or past the maximum number of changes is refused with HTTP 422 (tell the user the merchant does not allow it; do not retry). Confirm with the user before calling. PATCH /v3/bookings/{id}/cancel.

tools.name: agendapro_list_clients
tools.title: List clients
tools.description: List the business's clients (customers) page by page: name, email, phone, identification number, address, birth date, record number, active flag. Personal data: only use it for the task at hand. To find one person use agendapro_search_clients. GET /v3/clients.

page.description: Page number, from 1 (default 1). Pass pagination.next_page from the previous reply.

tools.name: agendapro_search_clients
tools.title: Search clients
tools.description: Find clients by free text (name, email, phone, identification number or record number): a short ranked list with id, full name, email, phone. The fastest way to get a client_id. GET /v3/clients/quick-search.

tools.name: agendapro_get_client
tools.title: Get client
tools.description: One client by id with contact details, address, birth date, record number and active flag. GET /v3/clients/{id}.

tools.name: agendapro_list_client_custom_attributes
tools.title: List a client's custom attributes
tools.description: The custom attribute values stored for one client (id, name, datatype, value). GET /v3/clients/{id}/custom_attributes.

tools.name: agendapro_list_custom_attributes
tools.title: List custom attribute templates
tools.description: The custom client fields the business defined (id, name, datatype, mandatory, group, choices). Use the template ids when setting custom_attributes on a client. GET /v3/custom_attributes.

tools.name: agendapro_create_client
tools.title: Create client
tools.description: WRITE: create a new client. first_name is required and at least one of last_name, email or phone must also be given (AgendaPro's rule). Search first (agendapro_search_clients) to avoid duplicates; not idempotent. No message is sent to the client. POST /v3/clients.

last_name.description: Last name. On update, an empty string clears the stored value.

identification_number.description: National identification number (RUT, DNI, CURP...). On update, an empty string clears the stored value.

address.description: Street address. On update, an empty string clears the stored value.

district.description: District or neighborhood. On update, an empty string clears the stored value.

city.description: City. On update, an empty string clears the stored value.

region.description: Region or state. On update, an empty string clears the stored value.

tools.name: agendapro_update_client
tools.title: Update client
tools.description: WRITE: change an existing client (partial update: only the fields you pass change; it overwrites the stored value). PATCH /v3/clients/{id}.

last_name.description: Last name. On update, an empty string clears the stored value.

identification_number.description: National identification number (RUT, DNI, CURP...). On update, an empty string clears the stored value.

address.description: Street address. On update, an empty string clears the stored value.

district.description: District or neighborhood. On update, an empty string clears the stored value.

city.description: City. On update, an empty string clears the stored value.

region.description: Region or state. On update, an empty string clears the stored value.

tools.name: agendapro_list_sales
tools.title: List sales
tools.description: List sales (ventas): status (partially_paid, paid, canceled, refunded), paid and pending amounts, paid-at time, location, client id and the payment transactions. Filter by paid date range, location or client. GET /v3/sales.

paid_at_start.description: Sales paid from this date (inclusive), yyyy-mm-dd.

paid_at_end.description: Sales paid until this date (inclusive), yyyy-mm-dd.

page.description: Page number, from 1 (default 1). Pass pagination.next_page from the previous reply.

tools.name: agendapro_get_sale
tools.title: Get sale
tools.description: One sale by id with amounts, status, location and its payment transactions (amount, paid-at, payment method). GET /v3/sales/{id}.

tools.name: agendapro_list_products
tools.title: List products
tools.description: List retail products in the catalog: name, SKU, price, active flag, category, brand and display. GET /v3/products.

search.description: Free text over product name and SKU.

product_category_id.description: Category id, or 'none' for products without a category.

page.description: Page number, from 1 (default 1). Pass pagination.next_page from the previous reply.

tools.name: agendapro_get_product
tools.title: Get product
tools.description: One catalog product by id with description, SKU, price, category, brand and display. GET /v3/products/{id}.
